description: This file handles server-side rendering requests in a Remix.js application, including request handling, distinguishing between bot and browser clients, streaming HTML responses, and setting appropriate headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main server handler that sets CORS headers and routes the request to bot or browser-specific rendering functions.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering for bot user-agents, streaming server-side rendered HTML.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering for browser user-agents, streaming server-side rendered HTML.
